verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a financial-crime risk platform, so asking whether it covers fraud surfaces beyond checkout is a fair question. The evidence only documents sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, customer risk scoring, payment screening, transaction monitoring and case management. Nothing in the pack mentions account takeover, fake account creation, or promo and policy abuse detection.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, protection extends beyond checkout — account takeover, fake account creation, promo and policy abuse are scored and managed in the same system
